episodes.title: What's the Most Dangerous Cult in the World?
episodes.description:
Which cult is the deadliest in the world? That's what I set out to find, and it was quite a journey. From visiting the house where Charles Manson recruited his first followers to standing in the Marina where a controversial cult began, I traced the origins and the end results of the most famous cults in the world. You'll enjoy this video if you're interested in dark investigations and even true crime.
